## CFR versus USC

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

df <- readr::read_csv("../data/sup_citations.csv")
df <- df |> 
  mutate(year =  stringr::str_match(doc, "20[0-9]{2}")[,1]) 

df |> 
  group_by(source, year) |> 
  tally() |>  
  filter(!is.na(year)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(year, n, colour = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line()

```

There are `r length(unique(df$full))` unique statues cited. 

#### Unique citations per year. 

```{r}

df |> 
  summarise(n_unique = n_distinct(full), .by = year) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.integer(year), y = n_unique)) +
  geom_line()



```

top citations per year
